channel.title: Go Project — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Go Project (go).

item.title: CVE-2026-97032 — HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder race in net/http
item.description: HTTP/2 servers could end up crashing due to inadvertently modifying its HPACK encoder concurrently. This happens because the server modifies the HPACK encoder from two goroutines without synchronization: one uses the encoder to encode a HEADERS frame…

item.title: CVE-2026-94439 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — HTTP/1 server connection desynchronization after 2xx CONNECT response in net/http
item.description: When an HTTP server handler sends a 2xx response to an HTTP/1 CONNECT request and returns without hijacking the connection, the server improperly continues to read and serve requests from the connection. Since a 2xx response to an HTTP/1 CONNECT conv…

item.title: CVE-2026-78663 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams in net/http
item.description: The HTTP/2 server can refund connection-level flow control twice for the same data: Once when a client resets a stream (refunding data for any sent-but-unread portion of the stream), and again when a request handler reads the buffered data. A malicio…

item.title: CVE-2026-78669 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes in net/http
item.description: A malicious HTTP/2 peer can cause excessive CPU consumption in the client or server by opening a large number of streams and then sending many small SETTINGS frames containing SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE values.

item.title: CVE-2026-78660 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed framing-related headers in net/http
item.description: Historically, we have been rather lax about malformed framing-related headers in our HTTP/2 implementation, as they cannot interfere with HTTP/2 framing. However, this makes it possible for our HTTP/2 implementation to forward responses containing su…

item.title: CVE-2026-78667 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Lack of limit on size of parsed Range headers in net/http
item.description: When parsing a Range header containing a large number of small ranges, FileServer(FS), ServeContent, and ServeFile(FS) can consume an excessive amount of CPU.

item.title: CVE-2026-94440 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Memory limit bypass when parsing MIME headers in net/textproto, mime/multipart
item.description: Parsing a multipart form can bypass memory limits and read an arbitrarily long line into memory when the remaining limit at the start of a part is less than 400 bytes.

item.title: CVE-2026-97031 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Reject malformed ECH outer extension references in crypto/tls
item.description: Multiple ECH outer extension references are not permitted under RFC 9849; previously, a client could send a well-crafted packet that could trigger memory exhaustion in the server process by specifying multiple references. We now reject these as malfo…

item.title: CVE-2026-56866 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — HTTP/1 client connection desynchronization after CONNECT rejection in net/http
item.description: When http.Transport sends an HTTP/1 CONNECT request with a non-empty Request.Body, it writes the body directly to the connection without framing after the request headers. If the server rejects the CONNECT request with a non-2xx keep-alive response,…

item.title: CVE-2026-56857 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Root.Mkdir(All) can follow junctions out of the root on Windows in os
item.description: On Windows, when the target of Root.Mkdir or Root.MkdirAll is a junction pointing to an empty location, the operation can create a directory at the junction target even when that target is located outside the root. This only applies to operations whe…

item.title: CVE-2026-78659 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers in net/http
item.description: When "Trailer" headers are sent by a client, the HTTP server internally uses the header values to populate the Request.Trailer map passed to the server handler. Because Request.Trailer is a map, each entry incurs memory overhead. For HTTP/2 servers,…

item.title: CVE-2026-94447 — Checksum database bypass for golang.org/toolchain in cmd/go
item.description: Previously, a user operating inside of a malicious Go project that defines a bogus golang.org/toolchain go.sum entry and operates a malicious GOMODPROXY the user chooses to use can bypass the intended checksum. We now ensure that golang.org/toolchain…

item.title: CVE-2026-94444 — Checksum bypass for golang.org/fips140 in cmd/go
item.description: Previously, a user operating inside of a malicious Go project that defines a bogus golang.org/fips140 and operates a malicious GOMODPROXY the user chooses to connect to can serve an arbitrary module in its place. We now unpack the trusted ziphash for…

item.title: CVE-2026-97030 — Recognize yield as regexp preceder keyword in html/template
item.description: A trusted template author may have previously written a valid template wherein the use of the 'yield' keyword would not be correctly escaped. We now ensure that valid keyword uses are escaped and non-keyword uses are not escaped.

item.title: CVE-2026-94448 — Reset context tracking on consecutive template expressions in html/template
item.description: When a JavaScript template literal contains consecutive expressions, the context tracking state was not properly reset upon entering a new expression. We now ensure that template-literal expression entries correctly reset context variables so all sub…

item.title: CVE-2026-56851 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Panic parsing crafted input in x/text/secure/precis in golang.org/x/text
item.description: The Nickname profile can panic with an out-of-bounds slice error when transforming crafted input into a short destination buffer.

item.title: CVE-2026-94445 · 8.8 HIGH 🌩️ — Malicious user input may lead to RCE in golang.org/x/playground
item.description: A malicious txtar could escape the intended execution context and force arbitrary writes to the playground host's trusted filesystem. Disjointly, one of the three possible paths to invoke go vet on the playground host did not correctly restrict the e…

item.title: CVE-2026-56855 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Prevent DoS on deadlocked established channel in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh
item.description: Previously, after a channel has been established, a malicious peer could send crafted messages that would deadlock the entire connection. Now, we handle all RFC 4254 channel messages; global requests are handled explicitly. Then, treat all other mess…

item.title: CVE-2026-78662 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Prevent DoS on deadlocked undecided channel in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh
item.description: Previously, a channel registered in the mux's chanList is not usable until it is established. A malicious peer was able flood the channel's incomingRequests, deadlocking the entire connection. Now, we add an atomic established state, set when a chann…

item.title: CVE-2026-56854 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Source-address critical option not enforced for non-public-key auth callbacks in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh
item.description: The source-address critical option in the Permissions returned by an authentication callback was only enforced for the PublicKeyCallback and VerifiedPublicKeyCallback paths, extending the fix for CVE-2026-46595. Permissions returned by the PasswordCa…

item.title: CVE-2026-46603 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Excessive memory allocation during VP8L decoding in golang.org/x/image
item.description: VP8L decoding in golang.org/x/image/vp8l can allocate an excessive amount of memory when processing a crafted VP8L image containing many unused Huffman tree groups. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via memory exhaustion.

item.title: CVE-2026-56860 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Avoid quadratic complexity in resolvePath in net/url
item.description: Previously, resolving relative paths containing parent directory ('..') segments performed string conversions and buffer rewrites on each step, resulting in quadratic time complexity and high memory allocation overhead. Now, path resolution operates…

item.title: CVE-2026-56864 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Ignore unrelated, unauthenticated hashes in Lookup in golang.org/x/mod/sumdb
item.description: A malicious GOSUMDB was capable of serving arbitrary module content not contained within the transparency log. This attack allows for a coordinating GOPROXY and GOSUMDB to serve a client malicious module content that cannot be detected by evaluating…

item.title: CVE-2026-56865 · 8.4 HIGH — Fix transparency log tile verification bypass in golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog
item.description: A malicious GOPROXY was previously capable of forging up to two sumdb tiles that allow for a requested module to bypass the GOSUMDB check and persist attacker-controlled module content to a local Go module cache. This attack allows for a malicious GO…

item.title: CVE-2026-56858 · 6.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Fix Javascript regexp context tracking in html/template
item.description: Previously, pathological inputs could close an unescaped '/' early, allowing for attack-controlled data to inject arbitrary content, potentially leading to XSS.

item.title: CVE-2026-56862 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Limit handshake messages we are willing to accept post-handshake in crypto/tls
item.description: Handshake messages, such as KeyUpdate, are always considered as state-advancing, regardless of whether a handshake has been completed or not. As a result, a malicious client can keep sending KeyUpdate messages to force the server to keep performing k…

item.title: CVE-2026-56853 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Apply ReadHeaderTimeout when doing unencrypted HTTP/2 check in net/http
item.description: When a server is configured to support unencrypted HTTP/2, it reads a few bytes from each new connection to see if they contain the HTTP/2 client preface. ReadHeaderTimeout is unexpectedly not being applied when doing this.

item.title: CVE-2026-56859 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Add recursion depth guard during decode in encoding/xml
item.description: Previously, DecodeElement would reset the depth counter causing it to never fire; this could lead to stack exhaustion.

item.title: CVE-2026-33818 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
item.description: Enforce a recursion limit in Unmarshal to prevent stack exhaustion when parsing deeply-nested, recursive structures.

item.title: CVE-2026-56852 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Infinite loop on invalid input in golang.org/x/text
item.description: A norm.Iter can enter an infinite loop when handling input containing invalid UTF-8 bytes.

item.title: CVE-2026-46600 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Parsing an invalid SVCB or HTTPS RR can panic in golang.org/x/net/dns/dnsmessage
item.description: Parsing an invalid SVCB or HTTPS RR can panic when the size of a parameter value overflows the message buffer.

item.title: CVE-2026-42505 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking Encrypted Client Hello privacy leak in crypto/tls
item.description: Handshakes which used Encrypted Client Hello could be de-anonymized by a passive network observer due to a disclosure of pre-shared key identities in the unencrypted client hello.

item.title: CVE-2026-39822 · 7.8 HIGH — Root escape via symlink plus trailing slash in os
item.description: On Unix systems, opening a file in an os.Root improperly follows symlinks to locations outside of the Root when the final path component of the a path is a symbolic link and the path ends in /. For example, 'root.Open("symlink/")' will open "symlink"…

item.title: CVE-2026-46604 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Panic decoding image with out-of-bounds strip offset in x/image/tiff in golang.org/x/image
item.description: The TIFF decoder can panic when decoding an invalid image with an out-of-bounds strip offset.

item.title: CVE-2026-46602 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Lack of limit on tile sizes in x/image/tiff in golang.org/x/image
item.description: The TIFF decoder does not set a limit on the size of tiles in tiled images, permitting a malicious or corrupt image containing a very large tile to cause unbounded memory consumption.

item.title: CVE-2026-46601 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Panic on VP8 alpha channel size mismatch in x/image/webp in golang.org/x/image
item.description: The webp decoder can panic when processing a VP8 chunk with dimensions that do not match the canvas size.

item.title: CVE-2026-42507 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Arbitrary inputs are included in errors without any escaping in net/textproto
item.description: When returning errors, functions in the net/textproto package would include its input as part of the error. This might allow an attacker to inject misleading content to errors that are printed or logged.

item.title: CVE-2026-42504 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Quadratic complexity in WordDecoder.DecodeHeader in mime
item.description: Decoding a maliciously-crafted MIME header containing many invalid encoded-words can consume excessive CPU.

item.title: CVE-2026-27145 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Inefficient candidate hostname parsing in crypto/x509
item.description: (*x509.Certificate).VerifyHostname previously called matchHostnames in a loop over all DNS Subject Alternative Name (SAN) entries. This caused strings.Split(host, ".") to execute repeatedly on the same input hostname. With a large DNS SAN list, verif…

item.title: CVE-2026-46599 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Excessive resource consumption in PackBits decompression in golang.org/x/image/tiff
item.description: The TIFF decoder does not place a limit on the size of PackBits-compressed data. A maliciously-crafted image can exploit this to cause a small image (both in terms of pixel width/height and encoded size) to make the decoder decode large amounts of co…

item.title: CVE-2026-42500 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Panic when reading out of bound palette index in golang.org/x/image/bmp
item.description: Decoding a paletted BMP file with an out-of-range palette index results in a panic when accessing pixels in the invalid image.

item.title: CVE-2026-39824 · 3.3 LOW — Invoking integer overflow in NewNTUnicodeString in golang.org/x/sys/windows
item.description: NewNTUnicodeString does not check for string length overflow. When provided with a string that overflows the maximum size of a NTUnicodeString (a 16-bit number of bytes), it returns a truncated string rather than an error.

item.title: CVE-2026-27136 · 6.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking duplicate attributes can cause XSS in golang.org/x/net/html
item.description: Parsing arbitrary HTML which is then rendered using Render can result in an unexpected HTML tree. This can be leveraged to execute XSS attacks in applications that attempt to sanitize input HTML before rendering.

item.title: CVE-2026-25681 · 6.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking incorrect handling of character references in DOCTYPE nodes in golang.org/x/net/html
item.description: Parsing arbitrary HTML which is then rendered using Render can result in an unexpected HTML tree. This can be leveraged to execute XSS attacks in applications that attempt to sanitize input HTML before rendering.

item.title: CVE-2026-25680 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking denial of service when parsing arbitrary HTML in golang.org/x/net/html
item.description: Parsing arbitrary HTML can consume excessive CPU time, possibly leading to denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-42502 · 6.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking incorrect handling of HTML elements in foreign content in golang.org/x/net/html
item.description: Parsing arbitrary HTML which is then rendered using Render can result in an unexpected HTML tree. This can be leveraged to execute XSS attacks in applications that attempt to sanitize input HTML before rendering.

item.title: CVE-2026-39821 · 9.6 CRITICAL — Invoking failure to reject ASCII-only Punycode-encoded labels in golang.org/x/net/idna
item.description: The ToASCII and ToUnicode functions incorrectly accept Punycode-encoded labels that decode to an ASCII-only label. For example, ToUnicode("xn--example-.com") incorrectly returns the name "example.com" rather than an error. This behavior can lead to p…

item.title: CVE-2026-42506 · 6.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking incorrect handling of namespaced elements in foreign content in golang.org/x/net/html
item.description: Parsing arbitrary HTML which is then rendered using Render can result in an unexpected HTML tree. This can be leveraged to execute XSS attacks in applications that attempt to sanitize input HTML before rendering.

item.title: CVE-2026-46598 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Invoking pathological inputs can lead to client panic in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/agent
item.description: For certain crafted inputs, a 'ed25519.PrivateKey' was created by casting malformed wire bytes, leading to a panic when used.

item.title: CVE-2026-46595 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Invoking VerifiedPublicKeyCallback permissions skip enforcement in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh
item.description: Previously, CVE-2024-45337 fixed an authorization bypass for misused ssh server configurations; if any other type of callback is passed other than public key, then the source-address validation would be skipped.
